title: Presentation Review Intake
description: Input schema for the presentation review framework

presentation_file.description: Absolute path to the .pptx presentation file

project_directory.description: Absolute path to the project directory containing source documents and screenshots

slide_content_spec.description: Path to markdown file defining intended slide content. Auto-detected if not specified.

errata_file.description: Path to markdown file with corrections/errata. Auto-detected if not specified.

screenshot_manifest.description: Path to screenshot-to-slide mapping. Extracted from slide content spec if not separate.

audit_output_directory.description: Directory for audit output artifacts. Created if it does not exist.
